_comment: What this machine must say about samples/headless/sample1.png. Produced by the run this file gates, then pinned -- not typed from a specification. Regenerate with run.sh --bless after a deliberate change, and say in the commit message why the number moved.

tolerance._comment: Position to 10 um -- the part is drawn at 0.0125 mm/px, so 10 um is under one pixel and any real drift shows. Similarity is a floor, not a window: a better match is not a regression.
